base.construction: fixed Gaussian smoothing of the GT proxy grid

implicit_grid.construction: Open3D closest-triangle signed field sampled once; trilinear generic zero-set evaluation

sign_proxy_repair.method: one centroid fan cap per original boundary loop; visible triangles unchanged

bunny.source: Stanford University Computer Graphics Laboratory, Stanford 3D Scanning Repository

configuration.fixed_cell_locality: bilinear projection proposes at most four pixels per surface sample; nearest-depth ownership retains a sparse normalized COO appearance operator
configuration.projection: orthographic using existing physical camera frames/extents
configuration.reduction_selection_score: 0.45 * silhouette IoU + 0.35 * SSIM + 0.20 * two-pixel-tolerant edge F1

missing_or_insufficient.appearance: coordinate-coded emitter colors expose packet identity/location
missing_or_insufficient.compositing: one event color is splatted; no visible-surface reconstruction
missing_or_insufficient.depth_ordering: packet flight time is not camera-space surface depth
missing_or_insufficient.detector_reduction: reduces stochastic arrivals rather than projected surface support
missing_or_insufficient.ownership: earliest packet arrival owns a detector cell, not nearest visible surface
missing_or_insufficient.projection: outward cone intersection with a plane is not a camera projection
missing_or_insufficient.visibility: surface self-occlusion exists along packet paths, but not camera-ray visibility

diagnosis.new_operator: One deterministic shared zero-set surface state is orthographically projected into each camera. The selected nearest_depth/bilinear detector rule establishes camera-space visibility and local pixel support. The resulting normalized COO operator maps local surface appearance to pixels.
diagnosis.old_operator: I[u] = C[e(q*)], where q* is the earliest surviving outward packet landing at detector pixel u; bilinear footprint weights visualize the selected packet/emitter event.
